findings.finding: OVH raised dedicated-server prices from 1 Sep for new orders and from 1 Oct 2026 on renewals of Advance/Game/Scale/High Grade Gen2024/2026 (avg +28% / +51%), and unbundled Public Cloud storage and IPv4 from 1 Oct. That gives the first FY27 revenue guide a mechanical lift above FY26's 5-7%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The FY26 guide (5-7% vs ~10% expected) cost -20.3% on 2025-10-21. The H1 2024 guide cut cost about -28% over several days.
findings.original_quote: En moyenne, OVHcloud annonce ainsi une hausse de 28 % sur les serveurs de génération 2024 et de 51 % sur ceux de génération 2026. [On average, OVHcloud announces a 28% increase on 2024-generation servers and 51% on 2026-generation ones.]
findings.why_not_priced: The rises are public since 10 Aug and sell-side has them. If fully priced, the stock would not have fallen 22% from its 22 Sep peak while renewals began on 1 Oct. Cost pass-through, churn risk (existing options rise 3-6x less) and Klaba's history of conservative guides leave it partly priced at best.
findings.independence: OVH's own Public Cloud pricing post: https://blog.ovhcloud.com/en/posts/public-cloud-pricing-update-october-2026/

findings.finding: OVH's RAM cost index stood at 604 (June 2025 = 100) by June 2026, and the company expects RAM and disk prices to keep rising in 2027. Adj. capex was already raised to 33-35% and excludes a financed FY27 inventory build. So the FY27 capex and levered-FCF guide, the line Luceco-type reactions turn on, is the likely negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The capex guide raised to 33-35% at H1 (2026-04-09) went with -5.8%. Q3 (2026-06-25), with that capex guide confirmed, fell -16.7% despite growth accelerating. Morgan Stanley's memory-driven downgrade (2026-03-17) cost -4%.
findings.original_quote: sa guidance de capex ajustés en pourcentage du chiffre d'affaires est portée à 33-35% (contre 30-32% précédemment), hors anticipation de stocks pour l'exercice 2027 couverte par un financement dédié. [its adjusted capex guidance as a % of revenue is raised to 33-35% (from 30-32%), excluding FY2027 inventory pre-purchases covered by dedicated financing.] Also justgeek 2026-08-10: 'OVHcloud s'attend désormais à ce que les prix de la RAM et des disques continuent d'augmenter en 2027.'
findings.why_not_priced: Memory inflation is known, but the FY27 capex/FCF number does not exist yet. The 22% slide since 22 Sep suggests some of this is in. TrendForce's 30 Sep forecast of a slower 10-15% QoQ DRAM rise in 4Q26 softens it.

findings.finding: The CFO who built the 5-year plan and the FY27 budget left on 31 Aug with only an interim successor. The FY27 guide and plan therefore come from an interim CFO, which TP ICAP Midcap (Sell) calls a governance risk factor.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The departure day itself was -13.6% close to close (2026-08-26)
findings.original_quote: la directrice financière avait participé à la préparation du plan stratégique à cinq ans et du budget 2027 [the CFO had taken part in preparing the five-year strategic plan and the 2027 budget]
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock took a -13.6% day on it. What remains is credibility risk on a guide signed off under an interim CFO, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: Q3 FY26 organic growth accelerated to 6.9% (9M +6.0%), and RAM/disk option prices on new orders rose from 1 Jul. Q4 likely prints 7-8%, putting FY26 around +6.3%: inside the 5-7% guide, a small beat on the midpoint.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3's acceleration was sold at -16.7%. Q1's 6.0% got +2.0%.
findings.original_quote: Accélération de la croissance au troisième trimestre [Acceleration of growth in the third quarter]
findings.why_not_priced: Lands inside the company's own guide, so the market was told to expect it. Near 0.
findings.independence: https://forgetaboutit.fr/blog/ovhcloud-prix-augmentation-septembre-octobre-2026/ (RAM options repriced on new orders from 1 Jul 2026)

findings.finding: OVH pre-bought FY27 components ('locked-in stock') under dedicated financing before the later RAM rises. Klaba says the company 'successfully anticipated' the June rises. It is now repricing to replacement cost while holding cheaper stock, a possible FY27 gross-margin tailwind, offset by the cash tied up in inventory.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print on this line
findings.why_not_priced: The size of the stock and its financing have never been disclosed. If the market credited the margin hedge, the 22% slide into the print would not sit beside the price rises.

baseline_tension: The price rises cut against the -21.5% run-up and the small positive priced lean (+1.1). The memory/FCF line and the name's habit of selling prints agree with the slide. Net, the evidence is balanced.
language_note: The French press (abcbourse, tradingsat/BFM) carried TP ICAP Midcap's Sell rating and the detail that the departed CFO built the 5-year plan and FY27 budget. The English wires carried neither.

French tech press (justgeek, forgetaboutit, clubic) carried the server-by-server price grid (+28%/+51%, up to +87%) and Klaba's view that RAM prices keep rising into 2027. English coverage was only the company's own blog.
The French AOF/Zonebourse copy stated the capex guide raise from 30-32% to 33-35% explicitly; the English press release only gives the new range.
lessons_applied: 'Cash can outweigh a raised guide' (Luceco, inventory build): memory/capex-FCF guide finding moved from -2.0 to -2.5, and the locked-in-stock financing finding moved from +0.8 to +0.3 because it is an inventory build that ties up cash
'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': Q4/FY26 revenue inside the guide moved from +0.5 to +0.2
'The move is in the guide' / 'size the move, let reaction history move p_up': abs_move kept at 11 and p_up moved from 49 to 48 as the net finding sign turned slightly negative
